name: Gqom quake kicks (808 iter walk)
desc: Deep 808 take on the broken-kick brief: a 3-3-2 kick cell walks around the bar via iter(8) so the displacement itself slowly rotates, pitched-down lt toms answer, micro-late hats add drag swing. Heavier and slower-feeling than the Visco sibling.

code.full: stack(s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~").bank("RolandTR808").iter(8).shape(${drive}).gain(${gain}), s("~ lt ~ lt ~ ~ lt ~").bank("RolandTR808").speed("<.9 .8 .7 .8>").gain(.5).pan(cosine.range(.3,.7).slow(16)), s("hh*4").bank("RolandTR808").late("[0 .035]*2").gain(.3).mask("<1 1 0 1>")).lpf(${cut}).fast(${rate}).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd ~ bd bd ~ ~ bd ~").bank("RolandTR808").iter(8).shape(${drive}).gain(${gain}).every(8, x=>x.ply(2)), s("lt lt ~ lt ~ lt lt ~").bank("RolandTR808").speed("<.8 .7 .9 .6>").gain("[.5 .3 .42 .28]*2").pan(cosine.range(.25,.75).slow(16)), s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR808").late("[0 .03]*4").gain("[.35 .15]*4").mask("<1 1 1 0>")).lpf(${cut}).fast(${rate}).orbit(1).play()
